data.title: Mar Cui gave Lulu and Georgia 1 star. Check out the full review...
data.content:
* * *

## [The delivery was terrible](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a4ac2eb3a99597cceab6a83)
The delivery was terrible. We were given a 3 hours delivery window (ok fine, that's normal), but the actual delivery time was almost 4 hours past the end of that window. The worst part is that the time would just update and get pushed back by 10-15 at a time, so there was no way we could plan around this. We called the delivery customer service and the only option they gave was delaying the delivery by a week. We ended up waiting for the delivery and it made us late for our evening plans that we built in 5 hours of buffer for.

June 23, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 7, 2026

Hi Mar,

Thank you for your feedback. I can see how this experience would be disappointing, and we appreciate you bringing this to our attention. We have shared your experience with the appropriate teams to help improve our shipping processes in the future. Please let us know if you have any further questions or concerns; we are happy to help.

Lulu and Georgia
